title: Wear App stops connecting/synchronizing after installing 3.0.0.2-dev-j  Commit#3d9b08e5 (compatibility break?)
symptom: After installing AndroidAPS 3.0.0.2-dev-j build #3d9b08e5, the Android Wear app stopped synchronizing. The app seems not to be connected, and Wear->RESEND DATA and Wear->OPEN SETTINGS ON WEAR have no effect.
cause: The Wear app version (release) is not compatible with the dev-j build of AndroidAPS due to big reorganization inside Wear dev-j.
fix: Update the Wear app to the current dev version. Later commits fixed tiles and other issues, but some problems remained; the final commit referenced suggests opening a new issue if something else remains.
evidence_quote: You have to update also Wear.
